The `WOW_PROJECT_ID` and `LE_EXPANSION_LEVEL_CURRENT` constants can be used to determine the current expansion level.

|Value |Constant |Description |FrameXML |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| |WOW\_PROJECT\_ID | | |
|1 |WOW\_PROJECT\_MAINLINE |Retail |`[BNet.lua](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/9.2.5/Interface/FrameXML/BNet.lua)` |
|2 |WOW\_PROJECT\_CLASSIC |Classic Era |`[Constants.lua](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/1.14.3/Interface_Vanilla/FrameXML/Constants.lua)` |
|5 |WOW\_PROJECT\_BURNING\_CRUSADE\_CLASSIC |Burning Crusade Classic |`[Constants.lua](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/2.5.4/Interface_TBC/FrameXML/Constants.lua)` |
|11 |WOW\_PROJECT\_WRATH\_CLASSIC |Wrath Classic |`[Constants.lua](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/3.4.0/Interface_Wrath/FrameXML/Constants.lua)` |
|14 |WOW\_PROJECT\_CATACLYSM\_CLASSIC |Cataclysm Classic |`[Constant.lue](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/tree/4.4.2/Interface)` |
|15 |WOW\_PROJECT\_MISTS\_CLASSIC |Mists Classic |`[Constant.lue](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/tree/5.5.3/Interface)` |

|Value |Enum |Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| |LE\_EXPANSION\_LEVEL\_CURRENT | |
|0 |LE\_EXPANSION\_CLASSIC |Vanilla / Classic Era |
|1 |LE\_EXPANSION\_BURNING\_CRUSADE |The Burning Crusade |
|2 |LE\_EXPANSION\_WRATH\_OF\_THE\_LICH\_KING |Wrath of the Lich King |
|3 |LE\_EXPANSION\_CATACLYSM |Cataclysm |
|4 |LE\_EXPANSION\_MISTS\_OF\_PANDARIA |Mists of Pandaria |
|5 |LE\_EXPANSION\_WARLORDS\_OF\_DRAENOR |Warlords of Draenor |
|6 |LE\_EXPANSION\_LEGION |Legion |
|7 |LE\_EXPANSION\_BATTLE\_FOR\_AZEROTH |Battle for Azeroth |
|8 |LE\_EXPANSION\_SHADOWLANDS |Shadowlands |
|9 |LE\_EXPANSION\_DRAGONFLIGHT |Dragonflight |
|10 |LE\_EXPANSION\_WAR\_WITHIN |The War Within |

## Example [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FWOW_PROJECT_ID%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D1&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]

```
if WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_MAINLINE then 
 -- mainline 
 elseif WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_WRATH_CLASSIC then 
 -- wrath 
 elseif WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_CLASSIC then 
 -- vanilla 
 end
```
